name: Kinetic Pin, Improved (Combat)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Kinetic blast class feature, Kinetic Pin.

Benefit(s): Whenever you use your Kinetic Pin feat, you can also apply a substance infusion to it, accepting burn as if you were using it with a simple blast (this burn is reduced by infusion specialization).
